author: Guerrilla Miniature Games
description:
We're back with The Indie Hour Episode Ninety-One! This series focuses on games you may have never even heard of and gives us an inside look at the wider world of independantly published Tabletop Wargames of all genres.

Ryan Dunfee is back with THE ARROW'S WAKE a solo-play Science Fiction adventure that puts you at the helm of a starship crew in distress. Procedurally generate a race across the stars with a deadly foe in pursuit. You can play with miniatures or a simple book of graph paper. Let's check it out!

Check out the the game rules for  HERE: https://www.drivethrurpg.com/en/product/582237/the-arrow-s-wake?affiliate_id=210041
title: The GMG Indie Hour Ep 091 - The Arrow's Wake by Ryan Dunfee
